senses.gloss:
√2sidh (sídhyati, -te; siṣédha; setsyáti,
-te; siddhá).
 —1. reach an aim, hit the
mark;
 —2. succeed, 18^17; be accomplished,
 18^22; become realized, 18^19; be
of advantage, boot, avail, 71^4; --siddha,
having reached one's (highest) aim, having
attained perfection; esp. perfect in
the sense of having attained supernatural
or magic powers; as m. a Siddha, q. v.
[cf. √sādh.]
+ pra, succeed; prasiddha, known, cf.
prasiddhi; aham prasiddho mūṣakākhyayā,
I go by the name of M., 47^21.
